title: $42M Housing Bonds: Public Hearings Ahead
meeting_type: Austin Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC) Board of Directors AHFC Meeting
summary:
*   Austin's Housing Finance Corporation took steps toward funding new developments.
*   Public hearings are scheduled for February 18th to discuss a proposed $22 million in bonds for a housing development at 440 Nichols Crossing.
*   Another hearing on February 18th will review $20 million in bonds for a development at 1934 Rutlin Drive.
